newhire_mike: Hey everyone 2 first day here. On an M2 MBA and following the onboarding guide. Installed Homebrew + asdf. After cloning the monorepo and starting the Docker dev services, several CLIs (pipx-installed tools and a global npm binary) are not found inside the container. On host `which node` points to asdf shim, but inside container it's missing. My dotfiles try to be smart and source both ~/.profile and ~/.zshrc. Any tips for a minimal dotfile snippet and how we wire pipx/npm into containers? Do I need to modify devcontainer.json?

aya: welcome Mike! We usually keep PATH/asdf init in ~/.zprofile on mac so GUI apps and shells launched from Finder get it. For the container: forward your user-local bin into the container or install tools in the container image. Quick host zprofile snippet:
```bash
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:$PATH
. "$(brew --prefix asdf)/libexec/asdf.sh" || true
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
```
This ensures asdf shims and pipx user bin are discoverable before system bins.

devx_lucas: if you're using Docker with user mounts we mount $HOME/.local/bin into the container in some repos. Check devcontainer.json or docker-compose mounts. For local dev we prefer installing dev CLIs inside the container image to avoid host/container mismatch. If you want host tools, add this to devcontainer.json mounts: "mounts": ["source=${localEnv:HOME}/.local/bin,target=/home/vscode/.local/bin,type=bind,consistency=cached"].

infra-bot: See internal doc: <internal/dev-setup/devcontainer-pipx.md> which has the recommended mount snippet and caveats. Reminder: never mount SSH keys blindly; use agent-forwarding.

samir: small gotcha: if your dotfiles source ~/.profile from zshrc it can run twice or in the wrong order. Keep PATH and asdf init in zprofile, interactive bits (aliases/prompt) in zshrc. Also run `asdf reshim` after installing node/python and `which -a node` both on host and inside container to trace resolution.

newhire_mike: thanks all! one more: I saw a note about `code .` vs launching from Dock changing PATH. I started VS Code from Spotlight earlier; does that matter for devcontainer terminal?

aya: yes, launch VS Code from a terminal (`code .`) after your zprofile is sourced to inherit PATH. But devcontainer terminals are spawned by the container shell; they won't magically inherit host PATH unless you mount or set it in container config. If you rely on host binary mounts, ensure devcontainer.json has the mount and the container's PATH includes /home/vscode/.local/bin.

newhire_mike: got it. I'll move the asdf init to zprofile, reinstall pipx into asdf-managed python (`python -m pip install --user pipx`), check devcontainer.json mounts, and then reprovision. Will paste outputs if errors: `which -a node`, `asdf current`, `echo $PATH`, and `cat devcontainer.json`. Thanks for the pointers!
